description: A task list's timesheet (GET /lists/:id/timesheet), read-only: each shift (who, clock in, clock out, breaks, hours; an open shift and a never-clocked-out one are flagged) and per worker per day the regular, overtime and double-time hours under the project's labor rules (overtime after 10 h by default), with totals. Optional worker_id. Read tier.
name: tascan_get_timesheet
